Tracking branch for UP-006 — `up` on a nameless bundle serves the forge
over plain HTTP at an address the operator supplies, with git over SSH
unchanged, and states through the CORE-002 event stream that the web UI
is unencrypted and belongs on a trusted network.

See `docs/functional-requirements.md` § UP and `docs/status.json`.
